name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Houthis hit Saudi pipeline 9 Nov; Riyadh fire
summary: Houthis struck Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline on 9 Nov; missiles at Riyadh intercepted 10 Nov; Gaza strikes continue
state: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted ballistic and cruise missiles over Riyadh and southern Saudi Arabia on 10 Nov, a day after an attack on the East-West oil pipeline in Medina region caused a limited fire; debris damaged the Aramco Tower in Riyadh on 8 Nov (Al Jazeera; Middle East Eye). The Houthi-run Saba agency reported coalition air strikes on Sanaa. Israeli strikes in Gaza continued despite the truce, killing four on 5 Nov (Al Jazeera). Cross-border strikes on the Yemen–Saudi front set the Alert.
for_you: Residents and travellers in Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Israel and the Palestinian territories should follow FCDO travel advice and local shelter alerts. Attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure tend to be watched closely by oil markets.
rubric_hit: Alert: major cross-border strikes (Houthi missiles at Riyadh 10 Nov; East-West pipeline hit 9 Nov)

rubric.alert: Multi-front escalation, major cross-border strikes between Israel and its neighbours, or mass-casualty events.
rubric.watch: Ongoing hostilities on one front, or a ceasefire repeatedly violated.
rubric.normal: Ceasefires holding across fronts (Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, Yemen).
